name: AfterTaxUS
description: Free educational after-tax investment comparison and portfolio income planning.

tools.name: Investment comparison
tools.scope: Two investments; incremental federal/state tax estimate; illustrative sample yields.

tools.name: Income calculator
tools.scope: Broad income estimate using backend federal/state and supported local tax settings.

tools.name: Portfolio app
tools.scope: Multiple accounts and income rows; what-ifs; baseline; saved versions; tax breakdowns; supported local and W-2 payroll settings.

limitations: 2025 model, not a complete 2026 tax calculation.
Not a tax filing service or investment recommendation.
Sample yields are not current market data.
Not every state/local rule, deduction, credit or personal circumstance is modeled or independently validated.
